_comment: Per-route gzipped EAGER/initial client JS budgets (bytes). #71: budgets measure only sync-reachable production chunks; async islands (scanner decoder and optional admin UI) are excluded. Ratcheted 2026-07-26 from the measured baseline (budgetFromMeasured ≈ ceil(gzip*1.03/1000)*1000). Never raise to hide a regression. /lookup and /team-lead were later added as new routes; the pre-feature /s/[token] and /self-register limits remain unchanged.
